method: Optional binary add-on: the reviewed ARM binary was reproduced from the ported source tree, and every third-party text it links or borrows ships beside the binary

details.distribution: sdk/optional/weniclaw ships the prebuilt ARM FDPIC binary (498640 B, sha256 above) with its README and notice texts; sdk/optional/install.sh installs it to /system/bin. The port source and its build script are maintainer material and are not part of the published tree; the reviewed build inputs stay recorded here for the audit. Zig build caches and output directories are local build state, excluded from the distribution inventory.
details.license: New WeniClaw code is BSD-3-Clause, copyright 2026 Nsing Technologies Inc. The one borrowed file is src/think.zig, the think-block scanner and stripping function from nullclaw commit 5f1cade05c19b6ecdfb9565ae3305e892e484da9, MIT, copyright 2026 nullclaw contributors; the full MIT text travels beside the binary and in the source tree.
details.linked_code: Built with Zig 0.16.0, whose runtime and bundled musl-derived Linux C declarations keep their own MIT and COPYRIGHT notices; both texts ship in sdk/optional/weniclaw/licenses/. The ARM link statically links libcurl (curl licence, shipped as licenses/curl-COPYING.txt, recorded by the curl component) and dynamically links the rootfs Mbed TLS shared objects (this build takes Mbed TLS under Apache-2.0, recorded by the mbedtls component). The WeChat text channel follows Tencent's published protocol documentation and is independently implemented; no Tencent plugin source or asset is included.
details.build: sdk/optional-src/weniclaw/build.sh host|arm, documented in sdk/optional-src/weniclaw/doc/build.md. The ARM build needs Zig 0.16.0, the SDK cross compiler, a libcurl archive built with eventfd disabled and the Mbed TLS headers; every input is either in this repository or a pinned upstream release.
details.upstream: WeniClaw is written for this project and is not a vendored upstream; the nullclaw file above is the only upstream text and is pinned by commit.
details.elf: ARM FDPIC (ET_DYN, OS/ABI ARM FDPIC, interpreter /lib/ld-uClibc.so.0); NEEDED libmbedtls.so.21, libmbedx509.so.7, libmbedcrypto.so.16 and libc.so.0; the two PT_LOAD segments are 477924 B and 19736 B before page alignment, so no large contiguous mapping is required.
